study.name: Retest: Phase 3a: H3 Consensus Voting — Track 2 (Text-Only)
study.description:
Tests consensus voting at elevated temperatures (T=0.3, T=0.7, T=1.0) using
the carry-forward text-only configuration (F1=0.660 at T=0.0).
T=0.0 is excluded because the model produces near-deterministic output
at zero temperature, making consensus voting meaningless (Erratum E32).

This is the first consensus voting analysis for the text-only track.
Phase 2b retroactive consensus analysis was only performed on the image
track (canonical library), so no prior text-only consensus baseline exists.

Text-only prompts have a substantially smaller context window (no base64
images), which may produce different temperature sensitivity and
consensus behaviour compared to the image-using track.
study.retest_notes: H3 consensus voting Track 2 (text-only). K=30 for full threshold sweep.
